description: This file defines the main page component of a React-based note-taking web application. It manages state for notes, selection, search, and UI responsiveness, and integrates subcomponents for sidebar and editor. It handles note creation, deletion, selection, and persistent storage via local storage.

methods.name: createId
methods.description: Generates a simple unique ID based on current timestamp and a random component.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new blank note with a unique ID and current timestamp.

methods.name: sortByUpdatedAtDesc
methods.description: Comparator for sorting notes by most recent update.
